title: RBI Cyber Security Framework (code-observable subset)
notes: READ THIS BEFORE USING THE RESULTS. Docket's restatement of the RBI Cyber Security Framework for banks and the Master Direction on IT Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices, organised by the framework's own baseline domains. Citations name the DOMAIN, not a clause number, because a wrong clause reference on a regulatory report is worse than no reference — follow source_url for the authoritative text. MOST OF THIS FRAMEWORK IS ORGANISATIONAL: board-approved policy, a CISO, incident reporting timelines, VAPT cadence, drills, training, vendor governance. Those are marked `process` and are never assessed, never guessed at, and never counted as satisfied. Only the minority marked `source` are answerable by reading an application repository, and this pack is not an attestation of compliance with the framework.

controls.title: Data in transit encrypted
controls.requirement: Customer and transaction data must be protected in transit with current, approved cryptography, and validation of the peer's certificate must not be disabled anywhere in the application.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Cryptographic and network controls
controls.evidence_hint: outbound calls with certificate verification disabled; permissive trust managers or hostname verifiers; plain http:// endpoints for an internal service carrying customer data; TLS version pinned below 1.2

controls.title: Sensitive data encrypted at rest and not stored unnecessarily
controls.requirement: Customer identifiers, authentication data and payment instrument data must be encrypted or tokenised where stored, and must not be persisted where the business function does not require it.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Data leak prevention
controls.evidence_hint: model or schema fields holding card numbers, CVV, Aadhaar, PAN or full account numbers in plaintext; an encryption helper applied at write time or absent

controls.title: Approved cryptographic algorithms only
controls.requirement: Deprecated ciphers and digests must not be used for any security purpose, and keys must not be embedded in the application.
controls.citation: RBI Master Direction on IT Governance — Cryptographic controls
controls.evidence_hint: MD5, SHA-1, DES, 3DES, RC4 or ECB mode used for a security purpose; a static IV; key material as a string literal

controls.title: No credentials embedded in application code
controls.requirement: Application, database and third-party credentials must be held outside the codebase and supplied at run time, never committed to source control.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Secure configuration
controls.evidence_hint: literal passwords, API keys or connection strings in source or committed configuration; a committed .env or properties file with live values

controls.title: Customer authentication is multi-factor and correctly implemented
controls.requirement: Customer-facing authentication must implement an additional factor beyond a password, verify it server-side, and bound the lifetime and reuse of any one-time value.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Authentication framework for customers
controls.evidence_hint: an OTP or second-factor step that is generated, stored and verified server-side; whether the OTP is single-use and expires; whether the factor can be skipped by calling a later endpoint directly

controls.title: Authentication secrets stored irreversibly
controls.requirement: Passwords and PINs must be stored using a salted, computationally expensive key derivation function and must never be recoverable or logged.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — User access control
controls.evidence_hint: a general-purpose digest applied to a password; reversible encryption of a password; a password echoed into a log or an email

controls.title: Least privilege enforced at the handler
controls.requirement: Every privileged or customer-scoped operation must verify, server-side, that the caller holds the required role and is entitled to the specific record being acted on.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — User access control / management
controls.evidence_hint: handlers fetching a record by a client-supplied id with no owner or tenant filter; admin routes with no role check; authorisation applied in some handlers of a module but not all

controls.title: Sessions bounded and invalidated
controls.requirement: Sessions and tokens must expire after an idle period and an absolute lifetime, must be invalidated at logout and on credential change, and session cookies must be flagged secure, http-only and same-site.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — User access control / management
controls.evidence_hint: session or JWT configuration with no expiry; cookie flags at their defaults; a logout that clears the client but not the server record; no session rotation after login

controls.title: Untrusted input validated before use
controls.requirement: Data received from customers, partners and upstream systems must be validated against an expected type and range before it reaches a query, a command, a template or the filesystem.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Application security life cycle
controls.evidence_hint: query text, shell commands, file paths or templates assembled from request values; a schema or serialiser validating the request body, or its absence

controls.title: Security-relevant events are logged
controls.requirement: Authentication outcomes, authorisation failures, privileged actions and changes to customer or transaction records must be logged with actor, action, target and timestamp.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Audit log settings
controls.evidence_hint: a logging call on login success and failure, on permission denial, and on admin actions; whether the record carries who did what to which object

controls.title: Logs do not themselves leak sensitive data
controls.requirement: Log records must not contain passwords, OTPs, tokens, full card or account numbers, or whole request bodies and authorization headers.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Data leak prevention
controls.evidence_hint: logging of request bodies, headers or form data; an exception handler recording locals; a debug log of a credential or OTP

controls.title: Deployed configuration hardened
controls.requirement: Debug and diagnostic modes must be off, default credentials removed, management interfaces restricted, and error responses must not disclose stack traces, queries or configuration to the client.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Secure configuration
controls.evidence_hint: debug flags enabled; default admin credentials; management or actuator endpoints exposed unauthenticated; error handlers returning exception text

controls.title: Third-party components are pinned and tracked
controls.requirement: Every third-party component must be declared at a known version through a manifest and lockfile, so that a published vulnerability in a component can be traced to the systems that use it.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Patch / vulnerability and change management
controls.evidence_hint: a dependency manifest and a committed lockfile; unpinned or floating version ranges; vendored copies of libraries with no recorded version

controls.title: Transaction operations are idempotent and server-authoritative
controls.requirement: Amounts, beneficiaries, fees and limits must be determined server-side, and a submitted transaction must not be executable twice by replaying the request.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Risk-based transaction monitoring
controls.evidence_hint: a price, amount or limit taken from the request body and trusted; a transfer endpoint with no idempotency key or state check; a balance check and a debit that are not in one transaction

controls.title: Board-approved cyber security policy
controls.requirement: A distinct cyber security policy, separate from the broader IT policy, must be approved by the board and reviewed at a defined interval.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework — Cyber security policy

controls.title: Chief Information Security Officer appointed
controls.requirement: A CISO must be designated, with a reporting line independent of the IT delivery function.
controls.citation: RBI Master Direction on IT Governance — Information security function

controls.title: IT Strategy Committee of the board
controls.requirement: A board-level IT Strategy Committee must be constituted and must meet at the prescribed frequency.
controls.citation: RBI Master Direction on IT Governance — Governance structure

controls.title: Cyber Crisis Management Plan
controls.requirement: A Cyber Crisis Management Plan must be in place addressing detection, response, containment and recovery.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework — Cyber Crisis Management Plan

controls.title: Incident reporting to the Reserve Bank
controls.requirement: Unusual cyber security incidents must be reported to the Reserve Bank within the prescribed timeline, whether or not the incident was successful.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework — Incident reporting

controls.title: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing programme
controls.requirement: VAPT must be conducted at the prescribed frequency, findings tracked to closure, and red team exercises conducted for critical systems.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — VAPT and red team exercises

controls.title: Inventory of business IT assets
controls.requirement: A current inventory of business IT assets must be maintained, classified by criticality and business role.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Inventory management of business IT assets

controls.title: Security operations centre and real-time monitoring
controls.requirement: Continuous surveillance must be in place with a security operations centre capable of real-time detection and response.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Advanced real-time threat defence and management

controls.title: Network segmentation and perimeter controls
controls.requirement: Networks must be segmented by trust level, with documented firewall rules and controlled connectivity between zones.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Network management and security

controls.title: Patch management cadence
controls.requirement: Security patches must be applied within a defined timeline based on severity, with exceptions recorded and approved.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Patch / vulnerability and change management

controls.title: Change management with segregation of duties
controls.requirement: Changes to production must follow an approval workflow with segregation between the person who develops, the person who approves and the person who deploys.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Patch / vulnerability and change management

controls.title: Prevention of unauthorised software execution
controls.requirement: Only authorised software may execute on business systems, enforced through allowlisting or an equivalent control.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Preventing execution of unauthorised software

controls.title: Anti-malware and endpoint protection
controls.requirement: Endpoint protection must be deployed, kept current, and monitored centrally.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Advanced real-time threat defence

controls.title: Anti-phishing measures
controls.requirement: Anti-phishing controls must be in place for customer-facing brands, including takedown arrangements for spoofed domains.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Anti-phishing

controls.title: Secure mail and messaging systems
controls.requirement: Mail and messaging systems must implement sender authentication and content controls to limit spoofing and malicious attachments.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Secure mail and messaging systems

controls.title: Removable media controls
controls.requirement: Use of removable media must be restricted, logged and justified.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Removable media

controls.title: Vendor and outsourcing risk management
controls.requirement: Third-party and outsourced arrangements must be assessed for cyber risk before onboarding and reviewed periodically, with the right to audit preserved.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Vendor risk management

controls.title: Backup and restoration
controls.requirement: Backups must be taken at a defined frequency, held securely, and restoration must be tested at a defined interval.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Backup and restoration

controls.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery testing
controls.requirement: Continuity and recovery arrangements must exist for critical systems, with objectives defined and drills conducted at a defined interval.
controls.citation: RBI Master Direction on IT Governance — Business continuity

controls.title: Forensic readiness
controls.requirement: Arrangements must exist to preserve evidence and conduct forensic analysis following an incident.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Forensics

controls.title: Audit log retention and protection
controls.requirement: Audit logs must be retained for the prescribed period, protected against alteration, and reviewed.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Maintenance, monitoring and analysis of audit logs

controls.title: Cyber security metrics reported to management
controls.requirement: Metrics on cyber security posture must be produced and reported to senior management and the board.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Metrics

controls.title: Employee and management awareness programme
controls.requirement: Staff and management must receive periodic cyber security awareness training appropriate to their role.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — User / employee / management awareness

controls.title: Customer education and awareness
controls.requirement: Customers must be informed about cyber risks and safe practices through periodic communication.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Customer education and awareness

controls.title: Environmental and physical controls
controls.requirement: Data centre and equipment areas must have appropriate physical access, power and environmental controls.
controls.citation: RBI Cyber Security Framework, Annex 1 — Environmental controls

controls.title: Independent information systems audit
controls.requirement: An independent IS audit function must assess controls and report findings to the audit committee.
controls.citation: RBI Master Direction on IT Governance — Assurance practices
